dialogues.speaker: Panah
dialogues.text: You might have seen me near the gate of Sumeru City giving out Akasha Terminals. That's how most people know me anyway, though I'm afraid the remembrance is not mutual...

dialogues.speaker: Panah
dialogues.text: There have been some personnel shuffles recently that have led to me being sent here to help our two standing sages and the Scribe out with their work.

dialogues.speaker: Panah
dialogues.text: I'm sure you know about the big shake-up that's been happening since Lesser Lord Kusanali assumed control over the Akademiya. I've been up to my neck in various applications from all manner of researchers...

dialogues.speaker: Panah
dialogues.text: ...And of course, I need to deal with people snooping around for information.

dialogues.speaker: Panah
dialogues.text: To be honest, I haven't quite gotten used to the pace of my new job just yet... but I'll just have to do my best.
